work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief II (OCR numeral I.) temporarily modifies the Hospitaller statutes on novitiate and caravans for Roman-priory alumni; LF429 in iis → LF438 peragendis across provenance LF432 and running title LF435; complete derogation and 14 January 1835 closing LF526–529. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF418–418; the source closing at LF526–529 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quarto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
